items.name: CatalogCommit
items.summary: A catalog commit that has been ratified by the catalog but not yet published to the Delta log.

methods.name: location
methods.summary: The location of the staged catalog commit file (e.g., `s3://bucket/table/_delta_log/_staged_commits/00000000000000000001.uuid.json`).

methods.name: published_location
methods.summary: The target location where this commit should be published (e.g., `s3://bucket/table/_delta_log/00000000000000000001.json`).

methods.name: version
methods.summary: The version of this catalog commit.

items.name: PublishMetadata
items.summary: Metadata required for publishing catalog commits to the Delta log.

methods.name: commits_to_publish
methods.summary: The list of contiguous catalog commits to be published, in ascending order of version.

methods.name: publish_version
methods.summary: The snapshot version up to which all catalog commits must be published.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(publish_to_version: Version, commits_to_publish: Vec<CatalogCommit>) -> DeltaResult<Self>
methods.summary: Creates a new `PublishMetadata` with the given publish to version and catalog commits.
